source: GitHub main; milestone statuses are curated plans and do not replace v2/tasks/status.json
completionPolicy: None of these enhancement entries affect the official V2 10-task completion percentage; unmerged or locally tested work is never DONE.

items.title: Evidence Explorer & detector-to-dashboard bridge
items.detail: Adapter and event click-through will correlate actual synthetic RGB/thermal evidence with map position, provenance and uncalibrated uncertainty. Integration has not passed end-to-end testing.
items.dependency: Rahil's isolated bridge issue #68; review PR #66 and draft UI PR #67

items.title: Optional real satellite mission-map preview
items.detail: Draft MATLAB prototype for simulated route/boundary/home over online satellite imagery. Unit tests and actual tile loading remain unverified; offline ENU map stays primary.
items.dependency: Mac MATLAB acceptance and explicit demo WGS84 anchor; not part of the live UI yet

items.title: Innovative Mission Intelligence UI & Focus Mode
items.detail: A clearer map/3-D hierarchy, expandable sensor/evidence panels, mission-stage ribbon and legible presentation-friendly controls.
items.dependency: Stable integrated V2-007 baseline and separate performance-reviewed UI branch

items.title: More realistic 3-D aircraft, terrain and sensor geometry
items.detail: Higher-fidelity quadrotor, more natural deterministic terrain and footprints/LiDAR overlays tied to actual public sensor geometry, with quality fallback.
items.dependency: Measured integrated 1× performance; V2-003/V2-005 geometry tests must stay consistent

items.title: Mission replay, scenario comparison & science debrief
items.detail: Timestamp-consistent replay, deterministic fault scenarios and evidence-based exports that show false alarms and the negative validation findings.
items.dependency: Official V2-006 and V2-007 DONE before starting V2-008 implementation

items.title: Nested sensor-quality truth firewall hardening
items.detail: Enforce strict nested public quality metadata allowlists. A missing allowlist was found; this is not demonstrated detector truth leakage.
items.dependency: Issue #69 review; preserve published sensor contract and scientific datasets

items.title: Mac dark/light-theme detector-demo correction
items.detail: Mac reported 100/100 tests and readable demo text after a local-only correction; original PR #66 still needs the patch published and re-reviewed.
items.dependency: Push local Mac corrective branch, review the exact GitHub commit and verify PR #66 before merge
